description: Display of one internally illuminated hoarding sign
decision_conditions: <p><span style="height: 13.1pt;"><span calibri="" style="">The proposed advertisement, by virtue of overall size, siting at a bend in the road and illumination would </span></span>pose a risk to drivers travelling south along the High Road (A409), in terms of creating a distraction that is not in keeping with the character of the area, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D11 of the London Plan (2021), and Policy GR9 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposed advertisement, <span style="height:13.1pt"><span calibri="">by virtue of its overall size, siting and illumination would fail to respect local visual amenity and would create detrimental impact to the character of the host property as well as the surrounding area, contrary to Paragraph 141 of the&nbsp;</span></span>National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies GR1 and GR9 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p><span style="height: 13.1pt;"><span calibri="" style="">The proposed advertisement, by virtue of overall size, siting and illumination would create adverse impact to neighbouring amenity at no. 207A/B High Road and 1a Whitefriars Drive, in terms of creating light pollution and visual intrusion, contrary to the&nbsp;</span></span>National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), and Policies GR1 and GR9 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;</p>
